hypothesis.statement: A returned P32 cloud request does not prove a usable facial rig, morph targets, or high-resolution texture sources, and those sources alone do not satisfy the AAA skin material contract.
hypothesis.action: Collect explicit UE Editor evidence for the expected MetaHumanCharacter, face SkeletalMesh, unique morph targets and named Texture2D sources, validate every source is at least 4K, and retain production and surface approval as false.
hypothesis.expectedResult: Rig and texture-source availability becomes evidence-backed while the separate layered-skin, deformation and runtime gates remain mandatory.

scopeBoundary: P33 verifies cloud output availability only
P9 still requires eight 4K skin channels, eight facial zones, six physical eye parts and seven Go close-ups
P12 still requires frame-level facial and body deformation evidence
Looking Glass Go runtime quality remains unverified
failureHandling: reject P32 job or receipt lineage drift
reject wrong Character or face mesh class
reject empty or duplicate morph target list
reject missing, wrong-class or sub-4K texture sources
reject request rig type other than JOINTS_AND_BLENDSHAPES
reject evidence that auto-approves or claims production readiness
decision: Use verified outputs as inputs to later rig and surface work only; never equate cloud source availability with AAA completion.
